I suddenly had a craving for Jjolmyeon, so I headed to Eunjujeong and stopped by Iwon Kalguksu, which I had been meaning to visit for a long time. Located in the alley next to Eunjujeong. To be honest, I went for Jjolmyeon because it was 2,000 won cheaper than Eunjujeong.
Dumplings 6,000 won, Jjolmyeon 7,000 won. If I had gone to Eunjujeong, I would have ended up eating jjolmyeon for 9,000 won, but I went to a restaurant that was cheaper for 2,000 won and ended up paying 4,000 won more for dumplings.
In this case, the definition of cost-effectiveness is shaken.
Anyway, the food was okay. From next time, I will pay 2,000 won more and go to Eunjujeong Pavilion.
When it comes to these types of dumplings, Nolbu Mandu is the best by my standards, but from now on, I decided to pay 1,000 won more and go to Nolbu Mandu.
Actually, tal noodles are the main dish at this restaurant, but they order it occasionally haha.
I took a quick look on the way out, and found that the dumpling skin was purchased ready-made and the noodles were factory-made noodles. Still, you don't use glacial acetic acid, you use real vinegar.
The handmade noodles in this house are kalguksu, and the rest are semi-finished products.

reviews.text: A bean noodle restaurant that opens at 11:30 and operates for only a couple of hours. Is this right here the whole time? I run a small, old store in an unusual location. There is a wait, but perhaps because it is a noodle dish, the turnover rate is faster than expected and we are seated quickly. During the bean noodle season, they provide one noodle per person, no need to order separately.  You can hear the sound of noodles being thoroughly washed in cold water from the kitchen. As you watch this as ASMR, you wait and see that the well-boiled somen are poured with soybean water from somewhere and served to you. The moment you eat it, a rich peanut-like flavor hits you. While Jinju Hoegwan and Jinju House have a rich seasoning and a rich texture, this restaurant has a more vibrant flavor from the beans, but has a lighter seasoning and texture. Because the flavors were so different, I thought I would have to take turns eating them. I didn't want to waste even a drop of the soup, so I ate it all up. Keeping in mind the owner's words that the original main dish, soybean curd, is more delicious, I thought I would come again when the weather gets cooler.

The fragrant smell of bean soup that lingered in my nose from the moment I mixed the noodles reminded me of the taste of bean noodles made by Master Kim at home. The springy somen also had a lot of soybean juice in it.

What's disappointing is that, personally, I don't like the floor and tend to eat a lot, but even though there were table seats, I was shown to a seat on the floor, there wasn't much to eat, and the portions were rather small. And 14,000 won for a bowl of bean noodles… I'm crying.

reviews.author: DASIT
reviews.text:
A Korean restaurant famous for Korean beef bulgogi located near Exit 4 of Euljiro 4-ga Station.

This place, which has been featured on various broadcasting media, is a long-established restaurant with over 40 years of business. It is always full in the evenings and is visited by many people, especially older men. It was originally famous for bulgogi, but these days, sirloin and marbled meat are also popular.

Visited at opening time of 10:30...

When ordering the signature menu item, bulgogi, the raw Korean beef is prepared at the meat corner next to it and then handed over to the kitchen, where seasoning and vegetables are added to prepare the bulgogi.
First, add a little broth and boil it, then add meat mixed with vegetables and seasoning and boil it together to make your own soup style bulgogi...

The characteristic of the bulgogi here is that they use fresh Korean beef, season it right away, and serve it, so you can feel the savory taste of the meat itself and it is very tender.
I also personally like the fact that the vegetables and seasoning are in good harmony, but the seasoning is not too overpowering, so it is not overwhelming at all.

The side dishes that came with it were all delicious, similar to home-cooked meals, and the type of kimchi in Gomsak in particular goes well with bulgogi.

You can add rice and other menu items to the meal, but noodles can be provided upon request. The taste of mixing it in the homemade soup is delicious, or you can make your own fried rice by adding rice and side dishes together.

Although they are all staffed by experienced people, they are friendly, use Korean beef, and the prices are reasonable...

It's a great place to end the day after work in a shabby alley and have a drink at an old restaurant.

reviews.author: Hong Soon-eon
reviews.text:
Wooraeok

A place that shows the essence of cold noodles eaten in winter. Wooraeok Naengmyeon has an extremely refined balance of broth, noodles, and toppings. The taste impression changes depending on the season, but the central harmony and proportion are always the same. So even if I eat it dozens of times, I never get tired of it.

The soup first comes with the spicy flavor of well-ripened white kimchi, followed by the deep meaty flavor that fills your mouth. The buckwheat-flavored noodles have a clear presence without being overpowering. White kimchi, radish, and cold-cut beef all go well with the broth thanks to the natural taste of the ingredients rather than relying on seasoning. Sweetness can only be felt in the stomach, and this understated sweetness completes the cold noodles.

It makes you realize that the appeal of cold noodles in winter lies in their strong aroma and deep taste. Drinking the noodle water completes the experience of a bowl clearly. A restaurant that is like a reference point for cold noodles that you return to every season.

reviews.text:
It is a single pork rib menu and the price is 12,000 won. Even when ordering additional food, you must order at least 2 servings and not 1 serving at a time. There is no brazier at the table, but the meat is grilled in the kitchen and served on a plate. Since all the meat is grilled and served, it is understandable that they only accept orders for two or more people. It comes with cabbage kimchi, green onion kimchi, red pepper paste, red pepper & garlic & lettuce, and hot and spicy bean sprout soup. The seasoning for the ribs was just right and not too sweet, making it easy to eat. I think most Koreans will be able to enjoy the taste of marinated ribs as they have been grilled over charcoal fire. It's convenient because it's cooked properly without smelling or burning, but the downside is that the meat cools and becomes stiff as you eat it.

It's a small, shabby, and old-looking house, so the kitchen where meat is grilled and soup is made doesn't look clean. There are many better restaurants in terms of taste and hygiene, but I think the reason people visit Gyeongsang-do restaurants is the memories and atmosphere. A fun drinking party with friends a few months ago, a happy drinking party with a lover a few years ago, a glass of soju with coworkers, seniors and juniors over rustic grilled pork ribs. As the restaurant grows older, the memories of its customers will accumulate as well. On rainy days, the sound of rain falling on the tent creates an even more enjoyable atmosphere.

reviews.author: A house that only tastes good
reviews.text:
A restaurant specializing in bossam

Located a 5-minute walk from Exit 6 of Jongno 5-ga Station.
Bossam Baekban is 15,000 won.

Kimchi visual~
It feels like the kimchi here has been given some strength.
However, it was slightly different from the savory taste I expected.
This is a place where kimchi and bossam are cut right when you order.
Bossam meat seems to be kept warm in a rice cooker(?) before being cut~
The meat was sliced thinner than expected, so the texture wasn't bad.
I wish I had cut this style of meat thickly.
Your jaw may hurt a little after eating.
Put kimchi on the front plate and top the bossam with salted shrimp.
It's okay to eat it with pickled garlic on top.
Surprisingly, the red pepper paste is slightly sweet and delicious.
Chili peppers can sometimes be spicy, so be careful~
A few side dishes are provided, and the seasoning is okay.
Among them, the spinach salad was good.
The overall amount is not enough for one meal.
However, if you are a meat eater, this is a disappointing amount.

Store & Tips & Review
The store is small and has about 5 tables for 4 people.
There are no tables for two, so it may be noticeable during peak times.
I visited at 2:30 PM on a Saturday, and I was able to eat right away.
You order at the table and pay at the counter when you go.
Cards are also accepted, but cover the terminal with a cloth.
The previous president retired,
It is said that the youngest brother will take over and continue the business.
The building is old, so it smells like an old country house.
If you are concerned about smell or cleanliness, pass~
I have visited twice since 7:30 on a weekday evening,
Failed due to running out of materials.
I recommend going around 6:30 on weekday evenings!

When I looked at the menu, it was Dongtaetang! I went there today because I was curious, and there was a reason why people gathered there.
The dongtae is large and juicy, and the soup is rich and moderately spicy. The soup is oily as the internal organs are also boiled, but it is not greasy and is light.
You can feel the slightly bitter taste of the intestines in the soup, but that makes the soup even more savory.
The side dishes are generous and appropriately friendly.
However, the amount of dongtaetang for men and women seems to be different, so I'll have to go again next time and check.🥲

Grilled eel costs 28,000 won, and for an additional 2,000 won, eel soup and rice are included, making it excellent value for money. It's a place with fresh ingredients, great side dishes, and a local atmosphere. Thanks to our friendly and attentive service, you can enjoy a delicious meal for prices ranging from 10,000 won to 30,000 won per person. Similar to other sundae soup restaurants, perilla seed powder and salt and pepper are spread all over the place.

Sundae Gukbap contains two sundaes and mainly head meat. I like how thick the soup is. A lot of Sundae Gukbap specials cost over 10,000 won, but this one costs 9,000 won. Usually 8,000 won. reviews.text: This is a Korean restaurant located in an alley in Yeonji-dong above Jongno 5-ga Station. Neosum means Yeouido.  Although the store is not large, it has the first and second floors. For lunch, beef stew and beef bibimbap served in a large wooden bowl are popular. Gangneung Chodang Soft Tofu is a white soft tofu with spicy seasoning sauce, and the tofu was savory and delicious. Water kimchi and freshly mixed geotjeori, which are served as basic side dishes, also play a part in stimulating the appetite. Many people drink makgeolli or soju in the evening. The vinegared squid seasoned squid with vegetables in a sour and sour way was plentiful and delicious. When it comes to pancakes, I usually order meat pancakes, but the kimchi pancakes I ordered were too sweet, perhaps because there were a lot of onions, and the kimchi flavor wasn't good, which was a bit disappointing. Overall, I was satisfied and enjoyed the meal.

reviews.author: Chang Seob. Kim
reviews.text: This is a restaurant that serves really delicious beef jerky and beef bibimbap for lunch. I went to dinner and tried pancakes, and the meat pancakes were especially delicious. ah! There are two types of kimchi served here, and it is a great kimchi restaurant.

reviews.author: Isaac Wang
reviews.text: Jeondo is very delicious, but Yukgaejang and Mokgye Bibimbap are the most popular. The rotation is very fast, and since the store is divided into two floors, there is relatively ample seating even during lunch hours on weekdays.

reviews.author: Sukhoon Kang
reviews.text: This is a Korean-style restaurant located in the alley right behind the Korean Christian Association Hall. We offer bulgogi hotpot, rib soup, and raw meat. There are also rooms that can accommodate groups of up to 30 people. It is recommended to make a reservation in advance as it gets crowded during lunch hours.

reviews.author: faster
reviews.text:
Perhaps because the Samyang Group headquarters is nearby, many office workers come here.
As soon as you sit down, you are offered water, but it is not water from a tea cup, but warm tea. This means that it is a restaurant with roots. It is customary for us to give warm water to guests when they come in the winter, but since when did it become a national rule to give them cold purified water? It is better to give warm water in the winter and cool water in the summer.

Looking at the menu, it is a bit pricey, but everything from the rice to the side dishes and even the sauce is delicious.
What I ate that day was the brisket nutrition casserole costing 14,000 won per person.
The sauce also adds perilla seeds and minced garlic to give it a rich flavor.
Freshly cooked rice has a shiny shine, as if it was made from good quality rice. The basis of a restaurant is rice. Everything is delicious only when the rice is delicious. As for side dishes, I received radish, spinach, kimchi, seasoned eggplant, and seasoned seaweed stems, and they were all delicious. I refilled the side dishes once more. The broth of Chadol Yeongyang Hotpot is very thick, so it feels filling. I ate a refill of vegetables once.

So you want to go again? It's a bit far from the office, but it's a place I'd like to visit again soon. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: mina
reviews.text: Although it is located in an alley, you can tell that it is a long-standing restaurant just by looking at the sign. The interior, as its name suggests, has a cozy hometown atmosphere with well-grown plants and decorations. I had the Chadol Yeongyang hotpot and the soup was refreshing and had a deep flavor. The brisket, vegetables, and soup are very delicious. Above all, the rice is shiny and savory because they use good quality rice. The side dishes are also neat and delicious. It's a satisfying place that makes you want to try other menu items as well.

reviews.author: B K
reviews.text:
A place I visit regularly as it is located close to my company.
The image of a house you can trust that exists in each neighborhood.

Although there is nothing special, it always guarantees top quality.
The menu is diverse and the quality is not bad.
It's not a unique restaurant you'll come across from afar, but it's a reliable place if it's within your area of ​​life.

I usually eat noodle soup, but the brisket is also delicious.

Makguksu (buckwheat noodles) is also a delicacy in the summer.

For people who mainly come and go to Jongno 5-ga
There will be no one who does not know this place.

reviews.author: Kim Kim
reviews.text: This is a place where you can enjoy a delicious meal close to work. There are rooms and the space is spacious, so it's good for multiple people to eat together.

reviews.author: B K
reviews.text:
A newly opened sundae soup restaurant located in a narrow alley.
There are many long-established sundaeguk restaurants in Jongno, so hygiene and service are often lacking, but this is a new restaurant, so there are no regrets in those areas.

Basically, they sell sundae soup that is slightly spicy, and it contains more meat than intestines. The food was well taken care of, each table has a touch pad where you can order, and you can eat additional side dishes on your own. overall
It's a delicious sundae soup restaurant, and the sundae is not a cheap vermicelli sundae.
It is a sundae that is properly filled with filling.

It's not a prominent location, so there aren't many customers yet, but it's a clean and delicious sundae soup restaurant, so I'm looking forward to the future.

Services such as ice cream and coffee machines are also provided.

Looking at the parts that appear in the Sundae Gukjeongsik, it can also be used as a side dish for dinner.
I don't think it would be bad.

A place worth visiting if you want clean, delicious sundae soup near Jongno 5-ga.

address: 1st floor, 31 Jongno 31-gil, Jongno-gu, Seoul, South Korea

reviews.author: B K
reviews.text:
A very rare restaurant near the office where you can have a simple meal with pork rice bowl. The pork is moderately seasoned and delicious. Toppings can also be added
It looks like it's a bar for dinner, but I've never used it in the evening, so I'm not sure, but the lunch menu isn't bad, so I think it might be pretty good.

Ordering is convenient as there is an ordering screen at each table.

I'll have to go there for dinner sometime soon.

address: 1st floor, 39 Jongno 31-gil, Jongno-gu, Seoul, South Korea

reviews.author: Heartless and greedy
reviews.text: I ate Obongjip bossam and grilled octopus stir-fry. Bossam is tender and edible. Even though the stir-fried octopus tasted mild, it was spicy for me. It's above average, but the level of thumbs up varies from person to person. There is a salad bar, but the basic dishes are disappointing.

reviews.author: Love Love
reviews.text: On days when I want to relieve stress, I often come to Obong House Jongno 5-ga to eat stir-fried octopus. They are always friendly and give me a lot of food! Bossam is so delicious.

reviews.author: B K
reviews.text:
A place that sells delicious and spicy stir-fried pork and stir-fried octopus.
It's spicy, so if you're into spicy food, try to eat it with a mild flavor.
It has a strong fiery taste that makes you keep eating it even though it is spicy.
The cost-effectiveness is not bad either.
A good place to eat for office workers.

reviews.author: Lee Gwang-hoon
reviews.text: It was the most delicious among all Obon restaurants in the country! As expected, Jongno is different!

reviews.author: Shinneti
reviews.text: I had stir-fried octopus and chive pancake and it was delicious. The octopus is big and plump. The spicy seasoning and cabbage have a nice crunchy texture.

reviews.author: Childcare Assistant TV
reviews.text: We are selling beef with a lot of fat in it. Of course, it's a bit bad for your health, but it tastes great. The sirloin part has a rice cake core, making it chewy and delicious. The raw radish vegetables are delicious, so it's delicious to mix it with rice after a meal, and the banquet noodles are also delicious because the broth made with anchovies is really rich. There is a sit-down table on the second floor.

reviews.author: for good
reviews.text: I went to the Hyehwa branch of Jangwi-dong Yuseong House. I visited on a Sunday, but I wouldn't have been able to eat there if I hadn't called. The opening hours weren't written, so I called. It seems like the grandmother and grandfather are running the business. If I don't hear from them, they probably won't open. I guess I'll have to call on Sundays. I wanted to eat Korean beef soup, but I couldn't eat it because they said they didn't have rice. It's slow, but friendly, and I liked that they tried to make sure I didn't have any inconveniences. It's an old store, but it felt clean and open on Sundays. Perhaps because it was daytime, it was quiet and had a nice feel. Even though I had to grill the beef myself, it was delicious. The anchovy noodles to finish were good. I plan to visit when I feel like beef!

reviews.author: sh Byun
reviews.text:
Sirloin is the best
The meat was the best the day I ate it.
I'm a regular so I go often.

reviews.author: Bombomdong-dong
reviews.text: The taste of high-quality Korean beef on sufficiently whitened charcoal is so good.

reviews.author: Lee Mi-hyeon
reviews.text:
32,000 won per person. Great value for money!!!
Korean beef sirloin is really delicious.

address: 1st floor, BS Tower, 12 Jongno 35-gil, Jongno-gu, Seoul South Korea

reviews.author: faster
reviews.text:
It seems like the owner has changed from the previous meat restaurant.
Looking at the review below, the menu has also changed. But it looks like the sign is still being used.
I think it has changed from a kimchi stew specialty to a pork belly restaurant.
The taste is ordinary. But rice is different. Cast iron pot rice is served.
The kimchi stew and side dishes are spicy and the cast iron pot rice is delicious.
It's fun to eat rice and then eat scorched rice afterwards.

The quality of meat is good and cheap, so this is a place I often go to for a meal or to eat out.
